title: TAT-3853 unfunded trade-screen deposit funnel
description: On a zero-balance Perps account, the order form's primary CTA is an enabled Add funds to trade control with a hint and a labeled available-balance Add funds control.

market.description: Perps market symbol used by the live flow.

proofTargets.claim: The unfunded order form shows an enabled Add funds to trade primary CTA, a hint, and a labeled available-balance Add funds control.

setup-unlock.intent: Make the wallet usable so Perps can load

setup-select-unfunded.intent: Select the fixture unfunded Perps wallet (dev6) instead of assuming Account 2 has a zero balance

setup-open-trade.intent: Land on the BTC long order form

setup-wait-form.intent: The sticky footer submit control is visible

setup-wait-zero-balance.intent: Available to trade is zero on this wallet

ac2-wait-hint.intent: The unfunded hint tells the user they need funds to place this order

ac2-wait-cta.intent: The primary button copy is Add funds to trade, not Insufficient funds

ac2-wait-enabled.intent: The Add funds to trade button can be pressed

ac2-kill-capture-helper.intent: Avoid a stale screenshot helper stealing the capture

ac2-screenshot-cta.label: AC2: enabled Add funds to trade CTA on the unfunded order form
ac2-screenshot-cta.intent: Reviewers can see the enabled Add funds to trade button, hint, and row control

teardown-restore-account.name: Account 1
teardown-restore-account.intent: Put the funded Perps wallet back so later runs keep their balance
